"""Hand-computed edge cases: expected values are derived from PROTOCOL.md by hand."""
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import harness, ref

BASE_TOPO = ['leaf-spine', 3, 2]
CAPS = [10, 10, 10, 0, 0]
GROUPS = [[1, 100], [2, 100]]
TASKS = [[0, 0, 5, 7, 1], [1, 0, 5, 7, 0], [2, 1, 3, 9, 1]]
Q = {'groups': [], 'nodes': [], 'tasks': []}

def session(edits_list, revisions=None, query=None):
    txs = []
    for i, edits in enumerate(edits_list):
        r = revisions[i] if revisions else 0
        txs.append({'revision': r, 'edits': edits, 'query': query or Q})
    return {'topology': BASE_TOPO, 'caps': list(CAPS), 'groups': [list(g) for g in GROUPS],
            'tasks': [list(t) for t in TASKS], 'query': query or Q, 'transactions': txs}

CASES = [
    # (label, edits, expected accepted, expected violations)
    ('quota of group with pinned member', [['quota', 0, 2]], False, [0, 0, 0, 1]),
    ('quota of other pinned group', [['quota', 1, 3]], False, [0, 0, 0, 1]),
    ('quota no-op', [['quota', 0, 1]], True, [0, 0, 0, 0]),
    ('quota up then back', [['quota', 0, 5], ['quota', 0, 1]], True, [0, 0, 0, 0]),
    ('quota change + move of same pinned task counts once', [['quota', 0, 5], ['move', 0, 1]], False, [0, 1, 0, 1]),
    ('unpin in same tx does not release', [['pin', 0, 0], ['weight', 0, 9]], False, [0, 0, 0, 1]),
    ('new pin does not protect in same tx', [['pin', 1, 1], ['move', 1, 1]], False, [0, 1, 0, 0]),
    ('weight of unpinned member', [['weight', 1, 6]], True, [0, 0, 0, 0]),
    ('cap edit is not a pin violation', [['cap', 0, 0]], False, [1, 0, 0, 0]),
    ('budget edit is not a pin violation', [['budget', 0, 1]], False, [0, 0, 1, 0]),
    ('bind pinned task to other domain', [['bind', 0, 2]], False, [0, 1, 0, 1]),
    ('class of pinned task', [['class', 0, 3]], False, [0, 1, 0, 1]),
    ('move pinned task into other group', [['move', 0, 1]], False, [0, 1, 0, 1]),
    ('move pinned task and back', [['move', 0, 1], ['move', 0, 0]], True, [0, 0, 0, 0]),
    ('both pinned groups quota', [['quota', 0, 2], ['quota', 1, 3]], False, [0, 0, 0, 2]),
    ('overload via weight', [['weight', 0, 200]], False, [0, 0, 1, 1]),
    ('empty group quota zero is fine', [['quota', 1, 0], ['move', 2, 0]], False, [0, 1, 0, 1]),
    ('capacity via quota raise', [['quota', 0, 9]], False, [0, 0, 0, 1]),
    ('no edits', [], True, [0, 0, 0, 0]),
]

def main():
    fails = 0
    for label, edits, acc, viol in CASES:
        req = {'version': 2, 'sessions': [session([edits])]}
        got, _p = harness.run_request(req)
        out = got['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0]
        want = {'accepted': acc, 'revision': 1 if acc else 0, 'violations': viol}
        r = ref.Ref(req['sessions'][0])
        refout = r.transact(req['sessions'][0]['transactions'][0])
        ok = all(out[k] == v for k, v in want.items()) and all(refout[k] == v for k, v in want.items())
        # committed state must be intact after rejection
        cert = out['certificate']
        intact = cert['totals'] == [2, 5, 13, 2]
        if not ok or not intact:
            fails += 1
            print('FAIL %-50s got=%s ref=%s want=%s intact=%s' % (label, json.dumps(out)[:220], json.dumps(refout)[:220], want, intact))
        else:
            print('ok   %-50s %s' % (label, json.dumps(want)))
    # stale transaction preserves everything and reports null violations
    req = {'version': 2, 'sessions': [session([['weight', 1, 6], ['quota', 0, 3]], revisions=[0, 0])]}
    got, _ = harness.run_request(req)
    txs = got['sessions'][0]['transactions']
    want1 = txs[0]['accepted'] is True and txs[0]['revision'] == 1
    want2 = txs[1]['accepted'] is False and txs[1]['revision'] == 1 and txs[1]['violations'] is None
    same = txs[1]['certificate']['totals'] == txs[0]['certificate']['totals']
    print('stale:', 'ok' if (want1 and want2 and same) else 'FAIL', json.dumps(txs[1])[:200])
    if not (want1 and want2 and same): fails += 1
    # rejection keeps every committed value: full certificate comparison
    q = {'groups': [0, 1, 1], 'nodes': [0, 1, 2, 3, 4], 'tasks': [0, 1, 2]}
    req = {'version': 2, 'sessions': [session([[], ['quota', 0, 4], ['move', 2, 0], ['cap', 1, 0]], revisions=[0, 1, 1, 1], query=q)]}
    got, _ = harness.run_request(req)
    txs = got['sessions'][0]['transactions']
    base = txs[0]['certificate']
    same = all(t['certificate'] == base for t in txs[1:])
    r = ref.Ref(req['sessions'][0])
    outs = [r.transact(t) for t in req['sessions'][0]['transactions']]
    same_ref = all(o['certificate'] == outs[0]['certificate'] for o in outs[1:])
    print('rollback:', 'ok' if (same and same_ref) else 'FAIL', json.dumps(base)[:300])
    if not (same and same_ref): fails += 1
    print('edge failures:', fails)
    return fails

sys.exit(1 if main() else 0)
PYEOF
